_source: BS Hamzići (Čitluk). The same system as BS Sjednica (Investor, 11.09.2026: the design cannot change) - module, stands, foundations, genset, tank and electrical values are carried over from bht-sjednica-final-review/cad/design.json. Site values (wind derivation, fence, derating, ventilation through the Stulz cut-outs, orientation, Stulz removal) come from the certified 2017 project GP-BS-10472-291 and the 08.09.2026 photos; geometry in cad/site_geometry.json. Dimensions in mm.

support.bom: custom-fabricated (off-catalogue on wind grounds, see wind.verdict) — Huawei Standard A-shaped 3.0 geometry conventions reused for margins/overhang only
support.anchor_bom: M16-M20 resin anchor, site-specific (karst limestone), not a Huawei part
support.source: Joint TD (11.09.2026): 4 stands of 1x3 landscape (pvsim/stands.py layout 4x3L) replace the 3 stands of 2x2 portrait on the Investor's instruction - separate small plates rather than one sail, and 2,43 m deep at 45 deg so the row fits the 3,30 m band on the true-SW side. field_slope = 3 x 1134 + 2 x 20; crossbeam = 2278 + 2 x 306,5 (margin convention of 07-calculations F.6). Frame mass is an estimate pending the fabricator's calc.

array._azimuth: 225 = true SW: the stand row runs parallel to the SW fence, in the 3 300 mm band between the slab and the lease line (plan north = true NW, Google Maps; Investor 11.09.2026). Not SE: tree, road to the NE. Facing S would save about 50 h/god of genset running - 07-proracuni A.6.

wind.verdict: The certified project was designed to JUS U.C7 with vm,50,10 = 25 m/s (gust pressure 0,41-0,56 kN/m2 at 1,5-4,5 m). Taking vb,0 = 25 m/s, BAS EN 1991-1-4 gives qp = 0,69 (terrain II) to 0,96 kN/m2 (terrain 0) at the panel top - above the 0,52 kN/m2 the Huawei catalogue support is rated for at 45 deg, so the stand is custom here too. The tender adopts qp >= 1,20 kN/m2, the Sjednica value, so both sites use one stand and one foundation design; the forces are therefore identical to Sjednica.
wind._stand: 4x3L (4 stands of 1x3 landscape) at both sites since 11.09.2026; at the site-derived qp 0.96 the overturning would be 20.6 kNm.

foundation._quantities: strip_d 900 is the FULL DEPTH OF CONCRETE, not a trench depth with a thinner footing at the bottom - that is what H-02 draws (a 900 mm block, hatched solid). 4x3L (11.09.2026): volume per strip = ((0.40+0.50)/2) x 0.90 x 2.60 = 1.053 m3, 8 strips = 8.42 m3. Excavation is taken to the underside of the blinding, 950 mm, at the base width 500: 1.235 m3/strip; backfill is only the taper wedge, 0.117 m3/strip, so nearly all the spoil is carted away. The superseded 3x4 had 6 strips of 450/550 x 900 x 3300 = 1.485 m3 (8.91 m3).
foundation._uplift_check: The full-depth strip is what the wind case needs. Overturning 25.7 kNm per stand over the 1600 mm strip spacing gives a 16.1 kN uplift couple on the windward strip; the strip's own weight 1.053 x 24 = 25.3 kN, factored 0.9, gives 22.7 kN - adequate on dead weight alone (pvsim/stands.py requires 0.74 m3). The chemical anchors carry uplift into the strip, not into the ground.
foundation.note: Same 8 full-depth strips as Sjednica (4x3L, one design for both sites). Depth and reinforcement are confirmed by the bidder's certified calculation. C30/37 XC4+XF3 is kept for one specification at both sites; at 493 m XF1 would suffice. Soil: certified project, sigma_dop = 150 kN/m2, no groundwater; karst, rock near surface.

genset.engine: Perkins 404D-22G1, 4-cyl, in-line, naturally aspirated, 2.2 l, 1500 rpm
genset.alternator: FG Wilson FGL10040, SHUNT excitation, AVR R120, IP23, class H

site_derate.basis: ISO 3046 / ISO 8528-1: -1 %/100 m above 100 m at 493 m a.s.l. = -3,9 %, and -3 % for 40 C ambient. Factor 0,931.
site_derate.verdict: At 493 m the derated prime (12,3 kW) is still below the 12,5 kW an uncapped rectifier system can draw, so the 9,5 kW cap stays; here it is 77 % of the derated prime (82 % at Sjednica) - more margin.

genset._source: FG Wilson P18-6 (Skid) technical data sheet 2019-08-14 — EQUIPEMENT/GENSET/P18-6.pdf. The Investor adopted 18 kVA on 2026-08-12, returning to the original first choice. NOTE the skid envelope 1550x620x1020 is IDENTICAL to both superseded sets, so no drawing geometry moved - only mass, thermal and electrical figures. The alternator is still SHUNT and the data sheet states short-circuit capacity 0 % without the optional PMG/AUX winding, so the tender's PMG/AREP requirement stands and is now backed by the sheet itself.
genset._superseded: P13.5-6 (Rev 7, 2026-08-11): 13.5 kVA/10.8 kW, Perkins 403D-15G 1.5 l, FGL10020, 302/308 kg, 4.0 l/h — WITHDRAWN because the site derate takes it to 9.7 kW prime, below the 12.5 kW rectifier draw. P22-6 (Rev 1-6): 22 kVA/17.6 kW, Perkins 404D-22G, FGL10060, 378/385 kg, 5.9 l/h.

tank._source: FG Wilson 500 l indoor tank data supplied by the Investor 2026-08-11: 1050L x 600W x 1310H, 170 kg. Supersedes the earlier unverified 1200x700x800 estimate; full mass = 170 kg + 500 l diesel @ ~0.84 = ~590 kg over 0.63 m2 = 9.2 kN/m2.
tank.secondary_containment: The tank is DOUBLE-SKINNED (dvoplasni) with interstitial leak monitoring, so the interstitial space IS the secondary containment and no 110 % bund is required. Investor's decision 2026-08-11. NOTE the arithmetic that decided it: a bund does not gain capacity from height, because the tank standing in it displaces the retention volume - only FREE area x upstand counts. The 2885x800x330 bund gave (2.308 - 0.63) x 0.33 = 554 l, clearing 550 l by 0.7 %; the earlier 1600x1060x330 gave only (1.696 - 0.63) x 0.33 = 352 l and never met 110 % at all. Any compact bund is arithmetically impossible: 1500x640 has 0.33 m2 free, so it would have to stand 1.67 m tall.

kada.basis: Drip/spill tray under the tank - NOT a 110 % bund; secondary containment is the tank's own second skin. It catches fill and draw-off spillage and drains to a visible low point. Sized to the tank with 50/20 mm margins. At Hamzići the tray stands in the SW corner against the south and west walls, 0,14 m from the genset; the east side stays the service side and the door path stays clear (H-04).

ventilation.duct: plenum od pocinčanog lima od prirubnice hladnjaka do postojećih otvora klima-uređaja Stulz u sredini južnog zida, sa haubom vani koja topli zrak usmjerava naviše

layout.intake_wall: ZAPAD - novi otvor uz alternator (sjeverni kraj agregata), sjeverno od spremnika; donja ivica +0,30 m od poda
layout.discharge_wall: JUG - kroz postojeće otvore klima-uređaja Stulz (u sredini južnog zida), spojene/proširene na >=0,36 m2 bruto; višak otvora zatvoriti panelom 60 mm; vani hauba 700 x 600 sa rešetkom na vrhu (+1,30 m) - topli zrak naviše, ne na FN polje
layout.exhaust: ISTOK - horizontalni izlaz kroz zid na ≈+2,30 m, ISPOD platforme stuba (+3,0 m), usmjeren na istok - dalje od FN polja (jug) i ulaznih vrata (sjever), sa hvatačem iskri i kapom
layout.tank_vent: kroz JUŽNI zid uz zapadni kraj, stojeća cijev između kontejnera i južne ograde (+2,80 m); prema elaboratu zaštite od požara, >=3 m od izduva i usisa
layout._rationale: Cross-flow W -> S. The Stulz is centred on the south wall (Investor, 11.09.2026), so the genset stands on the container's centre line with its radiator south and discharges through the existing cut-outs; a hood outside turns the warm air upwards, off the back of the PV array 0,77 m further south. The exhaust leaves through the east wall, away from the array, the door and the intake. The tower platform at +3,0 m sits over the roof, so the exhaust cannot terminate above it as at Sjednica. No tank position keeps both 780 mm sides clear: the tank takes the SW corner and the east side is the service side.

ventilation._verdict: Radiator 1980 m3/h, density-corrected to 2206 at 493 m / 40 C, plus 90 m3/h combustion air. At 50 % louvre free area: both 300x700 Stulz cut-outs together (0,42 m2 gross) give 3,0 m/s and ≈12 Pa, a 600x600 discharge 3,5 m/s and ≈17 Pa, the 500x700 intake 3,6 m/s and ≈18 Pa - far inside the 125 Pa budget.
ventilation._duct_area: Plenum from the radiator to the Stulz cut-outs in the middle of the south wall; ≈1,5 m2 developed with flanges - confirm on site.
ventilation._exhaust_run: ≈1 m flex + silencer, then ≈3 m horizontal through the east wall: 4 m x 0,52 m2/m + silencer ≈ 2,5 m2.

container.floor_note: Certified project AG dio §4.4.2 (Hamzići): secondary HOP U 100x50x3 at 0,51 m, primary beams 10,00 x 1,50 = 15,00 kN/m' - the same K2 floor as Sjednica, 10,00 kN/m2 (g+p). Genset 3,80 kN/m2 and full tank 9,2 kN/m2 act as concentrated loads, so the load-spreading grillage is REQUIRED as at Sjednica.
container.door_wall: SJEVER (malo prema sjeverozapadu; fotografije i Naručilac 11.09.2026 - ovjereni crtež iz 2017 je zakrenut ≈180°)

access.verdict: FITS - 620 mm skid through the 1000 mm door; height 1020 mm against 2150 mm.
